name: Hurda Fiyatları
author: hurdaci

sections.description:
Hurda Fiyatları: The Turkish Scrap Metal Prices plugin automatically fetches and displays current Turkish scrap metal prices hurda fiyatları in a responsive table format. This plugin is specifically designed for Turkish websites and displays prices in Turkish Lira (₺).

Features:

  • Automatic price updates from Turkish market
  • Responsive table design
  • Caching system for better performance
  • Easy to use shortcode
  • Turkish language interface (automatically detects Turkish WordPress sites)
  • Prices displayed in Turkish Lira (₺)
  • Translation ready

Supported Turkish Scrap Metal Types:

  • Bakır (Copper)
  • Alüminyum (Aluminum)
  • Kablo (Cable) hurda kablo fiyatları
  • Paslanmaz (Stainless Steel)
  • Demir (Iron)
  • Krom (Chrome)
  • Karton (Cardboard)

Usage:

To display all Turkish scrap metal prices like hurda fiyatları:
[hurda_fiyatlari]

To display only a specific group (use Turkish group names):
[hurda_fiyatlari grup=”Bakır”]

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to retrieve current scrap metal prices. The service is required to display up-to-date pricing information.

Service Details:
* Service Provider: Hurda Fiyatları (hurdacifiyatlari.com.tr)
* What data is sent: HTTP GET request to fetch price data (no personal user data is transmitted)
* When data is sent: Every time the shortcode is displayed and cache has expired (default: every hour)
* What data is retrieved: Current scrap metal prices in JSON format
* Service URL: https://www.hurdacifiyatlari.com.tr/price.json
* Service website: https://www.hurdacifiyatlari.com.tr/

This service is provided by the plugin author. No personal user data is transmitted to this service. Only anonymous requests are made to retrieve pricing information.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/hurda-fiyatlari/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the [hurda_fiyatlari] shortcode in your posts or pages
sections.faq:
How often are prices updated?

Prices are updated every hour by default. This interval is controlled by the caching system.

Can I display only a specific type of scrap metal?

Yes, you can use the grup parameter to display a specific scrap metal type. Use Turkish group names:
[hurda_fiyatlari grup=”Bakır”] (for Copper)
[hurda_fiyatlari grup=”Alüminyum”] (for Aluminum)

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the plugin has a fully responsive design and works properly on all devices.
